# ProtoPeek

ProtoPeek (Protocol Peek) is a local-first protocol workbench and independent open source project by Shreyam Adhikari. gRPC is the reference adapter today; Cap'n Proto and REST/HTTP are planned as protocol-native adapters.

Primary site: https://protopeek.shreyam1008.com.np/
Author: https://shreyam1008.com.np/
Repository: https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek

Summary:
- Launch ProtoPeek with no target and define one or more saved gRPC endpoints from the UI.
- Explore proto files, services, messages, enums, dependencies, and export raw `.proto` text.
- Generate starter JSON payloads from reflected schemas.
- Inspect metadata, trailers, status, latency, and run lightweight simulation checks.
- Keep a shared local shell while each future adapter preserves its native request and response concepts.
- Install with `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek/master/install.sh | sh` or the matching `wget` form.
